paragraphs: Rustify UI is an experimental Rust SDK for Leptos CSR applications in the browser, with Makepad WebGL2 rendering as an opt-in. Leptos owns the DOM, layout and reactive application state. The default build is DOM only and links no Makepad; with the SDK's gpu feature, each GpuRegion renders into a canvas positioned by the DOM, and applications send props into regions and receive typed actions back.

Each task implements only the rendering path it needs. Work on both paths requires an explicit requirement or a concrete need for cooperation across DOM and GPU regions. Shared state and theme tokens do not require matching component sets or CSS support. A specific application use case has not yet been selected.

This repository contains the SDK, DOM components, a Makepad fork and six runnable examples. The workspace is version 0.1.0, with publishing disabled. Use the repository quick start to build an example; use the SDK quick start to write a region or integrate the components into an application.

"__RUSTIFY_SAFARI_VALUE__{\"paragraphs\":[\"Rustify UI is an experimental Rust SDK for Leptos CSR applications in the browser, with Makepad WebGL2 rendering as an opt-in. Leptos owns the DOM, layout and reactive application state. The default build is DOM only and links no Makepad; with the SDK's gpu feature, each GpuRegion renders into a canvas positioned by the DOM, and applications send props into regions and receive typed actions back.\",\"Each task implements only the rendering path it needs. Work on both paths requires an explicit requirement or a concrete need for cooperation across DOM and GPU regions. Shared state and theme tokens do not require matching component sets or CSS support. A specific application use case has not yet been selected.\",\"This repository contains the SDK, DOM components, a Makepad fork and six runnable examples. The workspace is version 0.1.0, with publishing disabled. Use the repository quick start to build an example; use the SDK quick start to write a region or integrate the components into an application.\"],\"actions\":[{\"text\":\"Quick start\",\"href\":\"/rustify-ui/quickstart/\"},{\"text\":\"Components\",\"href\":\"/rustify-ui/components/button/\"}],\"islands\":0}"
